cn_title: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》玩家为地图投票争执不休
summary: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》玩家不满地图投票令Nuketown等经典图反复胜出，冷门地图无人问津，甚至有人因结果不满而退出对局。也有玩家认为，下班后时间有限，集中玩节奏更快的热门地图很有吸引力；争论显示社区对旧图的偏好正在固化。
subtitle: 老图霸场

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty: Black Ops fans are growing frustrated by players who refuse to vote for different maps.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》玩家愈发不满那些拒绝投票选择不同地图的玩家。

paragraphs.en: The recent ports of Call of Duty: Black Ops have been a strong source of nostalgia for many, but some are irritated by how it has created stubbornness among players when it comes to voting for maps. In the original Black Ops games, players can choose which map they want to play on in the next match. There are always two options, and then a third option lets you pick a random map. Players have noticed that, despite the fact there are over two dozen maps in each game, they end up playing on the same small handful of maps every time.
paragraphs.cn: 近期推出的《使命召唤：黑色行动》移植版勾起了许多人的怀旧情绪，但也有人厌烦玩家在地图投票上变得固执。在原版《黑色行动》游戏中，玩家可以选择下一局要玩的地图：总有两个候选项，另有第三项可随机选图。玩家发现，尽管每款游戏都有二十多张地图，他们每次最终玩的却总是同一小撮地图。

paragraphs.en: Black Ops 1 and 2 have iconic maps like Nuketown, Firing Range, Hijacked, and Raid, and because they're so iconic, it's what a lot of people want to play. Over on Reddit , players have pointed out that some fans aren't voting for less popular maps and are even outright leaving matches in droves if they aren't satisfied with the result.
paragraphs.cn: 《黑色行动1》和《黑色行动2》有Nuketown、Firing Range、Hijacked和Raid等标志性地图；正因为它们如此经典，许多人都想玩这些图。Reddit上的玩家指出，有些粉丝不愿给较冷门的地图投票，若不满意投票结果，甚至会成群结队直接退出对局。

paragraphs.en: "I don't mind playing Nuketown once in a while, but it seems like 70% of the lobbies will vote random, and if it's not Nuketown, 1/3rd if the lobby backs out," said one fan . "If Nuketown is an option, then there [are] 8 votes for it instantly."
paragraphs.cn: 一名粉丝说：「偶尔玩玩Nuketown我不介意，但看起来70%的房间都会投随机；要是结果不是Nuketown，房间里会有三分之一的人退出。只要Nuketown是选项，就会立刻有8票投给它。」

paragraphs.en: "Don’t get me wrong, Hijacked, Nuketown, and Raid are goated maps, but so are Uplink, Grind, Takeoff, Mirage, Turbine, Downhill, Slums, Meltdown, Carrier, and Studio, etc. Honestly, Black Ops 2 doesn’t have a bad map; even Magma, Frost, and Pod are better than so many of the new maps out today," said another . "Sometimes I’m just down to play on a map I don't like that much just for variety's sake, so I’m hella annoyed by this too despite loving all the maps everyone always picks, but not when it’s the only maps I’ve been playing on for the last 5 hours straight."
paragraphs.cn: 另一名玩家说：「别误会，Hijacked、Nuketown和Raid确实都是神图，但Uplink、Grind、Takeoff、Mirage、Turbine、Downhill、Slums、Meltdown、Carrier和Studio等也一样。说真的，《黑色行动2》没有一张差地图；就连Magma、Frost和Pod都比今天推出的许多新地图好。」他接着说：「有时为了换换口味，我甚至愿意玩自己没那么喜欢的地图。所以尽管大家总选的那些图我也都喜欢，这件事仍让我特别不爽——毕竟过去5个小时我一直只在玩那几张图。」

paragraphs.en: Some even noted that Black Ops 2 specifically has a playlist for just Hijacked and Nuketown if that's all people want to play, even suggesting that Nuketown should be removed from standard map rotations.
paragraphs.cn: 还有人指出，《黑色行动2》专门设有只包含Hijacked和Nuketown的列表，若玩家只想玩这些图完全可以去那里；他们甚至建议应把Nuketown从标准地图轮换中移除。

paragraphs.en: "Map voting is a curse in this game. On BO7, you'll RARELY play anything other than Nuketown, Hijacked, Raid, because everyone needs to spawn trap and get 100 kills, or the map is garbage," stated an annoyed player . "I honestly miss MW2019 when there was no map voting; I actually got to play ALL the maps. Every year a bunch of people are on here complaining that there's only 10 - 12 maps at launch, and then they still refuse to play on any of them except for 3. It's mindboggling."
paragraphs.cn: 一名恼火的玩家表示：「地图投票是这款游戏的诅咒。在BO7里，你很少会玩到Nuketown、Hijacked和Raid之外的地图，因为人人都要堵在出生点刷100杀，不然就觉得地图是垃圾。我真怀念没有地图投票的MW2019；当时我真的能玩到所有地图。每年都有一群人在这里抱怨首发只有10到12张地图，结果他们又拒绝玩其中除3张以外的任何一张。简直匪夷所思。」

paragraphs.en: "Takeoff and Uplink are the most skipped maps I’ve seen, and I believe it’s because people simply don’t know what they are," said a frustrated player . "And even more unfortunate due to rage bait culture asking people to vote for either becomes a massive vote for classified and ends up being Drone or Aftermath which in turn kills the lobby."
paragraphs.cn: 一名沮丧的玩家说：「Takeoff和Uplink是我见过被跳过最多的地图，我认为是因为大家根本不知道它们是什么。更糟的是，在引战文化影响下，请大家在两者中投票会变成大量人投给classified，最后抽到Drone或Aftermath，结果整间房的人都走了。」

paragraphs.en: One fan made a respectable case for playing nothing but the hits, however.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，也有一名粉丝为只玩热门地图提出了颇有道理的理由。

paragraphs.en: "I totally get it, but as someone who only plays for a bit after work every now and then, it’s fun just hopping in a few Nuketown games and playing super engaging games for a bit with the little time I have," argued a fan . "Also helps leveling up when you can get like 100 kills within a game or two, as opposed to maybe 3-4 of playing bigger maps."
paragraphs.cn: 一名粉丝辩称：「我完全理解，但作为一个只是偶尔下班后玩一会儿的人，在有限时间里直接打几局Nuketown、玩几场节奏特别紧凑的对局就很有意思。而且一两局就能拿到约100杀，也有助于升级；玩大地图可能要打三四局才行。」

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, Call of Duty players are creautres of habit. They know what they like, and it's very hard for some of them to accept change or adapt to new things. As a result, it means the franchise and the players themselves can get stuck in repetitive cycles, as seen in cases like this one. Many of the maps people are complaining about here have been brought back in other Call of Duty games multiple times over the years and continue to be very popular with fans, for better or worse.
paragraphs.cn: 归根结底，《使命召唤》玩家都是习惯的生物。他们知道自己喜欢什么，对其中一些人来说，接受变化或适应新事物非常困难。结果正如这次事件所示，这个系列和玩家自己都可能陷入重复循环。这里被人抱怨的许多地图，多年来已在其他《使命召唤》游戏中多次回归，而且无论好坏，依然很受粉丝欢迎。

paragraphs.en: In somewhat related news, Black Ops fans recently uncovered a cut Zombies mode from the original game. The mode is a tower defense version of the undead horde mode and would've been a very unique spin on the classic co-op offering.
paragraphs.cn: 另据一则相关消息，《黑色行动》粉丝最近发现了初代游戏中被砍掉的一个僵尸模式。该模式是亡灵尸潮模式的塔防版本，本会成为经典合作玩法非常独特的一种变体。

opus_summary: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》地图投票让Nuketown、Hijacked和Raid等经典地图频繁胜出，冷门图常被跳过，部分玩家甚至因结果不满而退出。有人呼吁调整标准轮换，也有人认为忙碌玩家更愿在有限时间里玩节奏紧凑的热门地图。
